description: Single-electron transistor: charging energy E_C, whether Coulomb blockade occurs, and why it does not when it fails. Checks BOTH conditions — E_C >> k_B*T and tunnel barriers above the resistance quantum R_K = h/e^2 ~ 25.8 kOhm. The second is almost never mentioned, and without it a design with perfect energy still does not blockade.
